summary: The first residual mismatch is the castmu fumble notice at step 242: C displays “The air crackles around the curate,” while JavaScript displays a different species name. C calls mon_nam(mtmp); the JavaScript caller uses monnamFallback(), which reads only mtmp.data.pmnames and bypasses x_monnam's priest/minion naming path. Replace that fallback with the existing mon_nam implementation while preserving the injected monnam provider, visibility/deafness gates, and message order.

source.branch: In castmu's random-fumble branch (mcastu.c:205-214), when the visible caster is not deaf, C sets the message coordinate and formats the caster with mon_nam(mtmp). The JS branch instead falls back to the raw species pmnames when no injected monnam provider is present.
callers: mhitu.c:mattacku calls castmu at mhitu.c:930; the recorded monster melee spell reaches this caller.
js/unported_monster_actions.js:mattacku delegates the corresponding production attack to js/mcastu.js:castmu.
dependencies: do_name.c:mon_nam -> x_monnam -> priestname; existing js/do_name.js implementations already preserve the priest/minion naming rules.
